camera.rule: Uniform scaling and translation only; use each reviewed rig's own foreground/clip layers. The cups bin repeats its reviewed front rail with its existing flipX flag.

scene.backgroundNote: The room remains a single unmodified PNG. It is uniformly scaled to 390 px wide; a cream continuation below y=585 is outside the cropped review composition. The left-wall window is independent. The left-wall door is shown separately in the side panel.

layerRule: Draw belt assemblies first, then machine and stock rigs in anchor-y order. Each rig retains body/head, content clip and front-guard order; connecting endpoints overlap within the ports, without stretching or rotating a belt sprite. Conveyor cargo has a shared scene width: 14 logical px for cups and 6 px for kernels, regardless of belt sprite scale.
notes: The zigzag chain is pop → bulk inventory → cup → cup inventory → ship → outfeed. Each belt endpoint is derived from the adjoining reviewed rig port, not hand-drawn connecting lines.
This is a static spatial and occlusion reference. It does not implement production animation, input hit targets or a game screen.
All cups reuse the existing cup-mouth fill clip. Box and dual-tray rigs remain supported by the renderer but first-generation shipping uses one filled cup.
Warehouse examples use bounded representative products; the independently drawn quantities remain authoritative labels.
